title: Table
summary: A data table. Two modes: hand it a raw table in the default slot (rows and cells exactly as authored) and it supplies the scroll frame, toolbar, bulk, empty and footer slots; or give it columns and rows and it renders the table itself, with sorting, filtering, selection, loading and phone cards. The data-driven mode: striped, hover, bordered, density, sticky header and first column, sortable headers, filter row, row selection with a bulk bar, loading and empty states, expandable detail rows and a card layout on a phone. Custom cell content goes in slots named cell-<rowId>-<key>; expandable rows show the slot detail-<rowId>. With manual set, the host owns sorting, filtering and paging and the element only renders and reports. At 500 rows or more (a fixed threshold; js/table-vw.js), a non-expandable, non-slotted table windows: only the rows near the scroll frame's viewport are drawn, and sort, filter and selection still act on every row. In data-driven mode, each row carries data-pk-context="<rowId>", so wrapping the whole table in a pk-context-menu can serve different menu content per row (see that element's context field).

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions: { key, label, type?: text|number|date, align?: start|end, sortable?, hidePhone? }[]. A JSON attribute or a property. type decides how the column sorts and filters, not how a value is shown: cells always show the row value as given, as text, and the element does no formatting, locale or time zone handling, so the host sends the display string it wants ("$1,204.50", "7 Jan 2026"). number sorts numerically and reads through currency symbols and grouping ("$1,204.50" is 1204.5; text that holds no number sorts first) and aligns to the end unless align says otherwise. date sorts chronologically by Date.parse of the value, so use ISO 8601 (a date-only value such as 2026-01-07 is read as UTC midnight, a value with an offset keeps it; text that does not parse sorts first). text sorts alphabetically with numeric collation, ignoring case. hidePhone hides the column below 640px, in the cards layout too.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row data, one object per row. A JSON attribute or a property. Custom cell content goes in the cell-<rowId>-<key> slots, expanded content in detail-<rowId>.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: The field that identifies a row.

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternate row tint.

props.name: hover
props.description: Tint the row under the pointer.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Border on every cell.

props.name: density
props.description: Cell padding step.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Pin the header row (give the table a maxHeight).

props.name: stickyColumn
props.description: Pin the first column.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Checkbox column with select-all.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Rows are activatable: they show a pointer, take the keyboard (each row is a tab stop; Enter or Space on the row) and fire pk-row-click.

props.name: currentRow
props.description: The id of the row that is open elsewhere (the record shown in a detail pane): that row is tinted, marked with an accent bar and given aria-current. The host sets it (from the route, or from pk-row-click); the element never changes it. Empty marks no row.

props.name: filterable
props.description: A filter input under each header.

props.name: manual
props.description: The host sorts, filters and pages; rows are shown exactly as given.

props.name: sort
props.description: Key of the column being sorted; empty when the rows are in their natural order.

props.name: sortDir
props.description: Sort direction.

props.name: filters
props.description: Filter text per column key: { [key]: text }.

props.name: selected
props.description: Ids of the selected rows. The user changes it with the row checkboxes and the element raises pk-select with the new ids; a change the host makes raises nothing.

props.name: expandable
props.description: Rows that have a detail-<rowId> slot get a toggle that shows or hides that slot under the row.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of the expanded rows. The user changes it and pk-row-expand reports each change; after that the host owns it.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a placeholder row, announce Loading and mark the table busy.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text shown when there are no rows. The empty slot replaces it.

props.name: cards
props.description: Each row becomes a card below 640px.

props.name: caption
props.description: Table caption.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the scrolling region.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Bounds the frame; sticky header and column need it.

props.name: flow
props.description: Slotted-table mode: no scroll frame, for a table inside a container that already scrolls.

slots.description: A raw table (thead, tbody, tfoot, any rows). The page-level layer styles it; the element frames it.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Search, filters and buttons above the table, laid out in a wrapping row. Give the item that should sit at the far end (an action button beside a search box) the attribute data-end: it and the items after it move to the end of the row. pk-table-filters (issue 203) fits here: a debounced search box plus a Filters trigger and panel around your own filter fields, so a table gets consistent search/filter UI without a page rebuilding that shell by hand.

slots.name: bulk
slots.description: Actions shown while rows are selected.

slots.name: cell-<rowId>-<key>
slots.description: Custom content for one cell of a data-driven table: rowId is the row's rowKey value, key the column key. Replaces the cell text.

slots.name: detail-<rowId>
slots.description: Detail content of one row, shown under it when the row is expanded (expandable). A row without this slot has no toggle.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Empty state; an pk-empty-state fits. Replaces emptyText.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Below the table; an pk-pagination fits.

events.name: pk-sort
events.description: A sortable header was activated. Each activation of the same header cycles ascending, descending, then cleared: a cleared sort reports key and direction null and the rows return to their natural order (a manual table reports it too, and the host restores its own order). Cancel to keep the current sort.

events.name: pk-row-click
events.description: A clickable row was activated by a click, or by Enter or Space while the row itself has focus. A click or key on a checkbox, button, link or select inside the row does not raise it.

events.name: pk-row-expand
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed a row. expanded is the new state; the expanded prop already holds it.

cssProperties.name: --pk-table-max-height
cssProperties.description: Height of the scrolling frame (set from maxHeight).

methods.name: sortBy(key, direction)
methods.description: Sort programmatically. sortBy(null) clears the sort.

a11y: A real table with a caption, aria-rowcount and aria-busy. Sortable headers hold a button and carry aria-sort. The scrolling frame is a labelled focusable region so the keyboard can scroll it. A clickable row is focusable (one tab stop per row, before the checkbox and buttons inside it) and Enter or Space on it activates it, with a visible focus ring; the controls inside a row keep their own keys. Each expandable row has a real button (Enter or Space) with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its detail row, and keeps focus after it toggles. The loading row carries a status text. Checkboxes name their row; the selection count is a polite status. The card layout keeps the header for assistive technology. Cell values are set as text, never parsed as HTML. The current row (current-row) carries aria-current="true", so a screen reader announces which record is open.

examples.title: Sortable, selectable table
examples.html:
<pk-table id="t1" label="Products" caption="Stock by product" striped hover selectable
  columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU","sortable":true},{"key":"price","label":"Price","type":"number","sortable":true}]'
  rows='[{"id":1,"sku":"AC-001","price":"$4.99"},{"id":2,"sku":"AC-002","price":"$3.99"}]'>
  <pk-button slot="bulk" size="mini" variant="ghost">Archive</pk-button>
</pk-table>

examples.title: Empty and loading
examples.html:
<pk-table label="Empty" columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"}]' empty-text="No products yet"></pk-table>
<pk-table label="Loading" loading columns='[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"}]'></pk-table>
